# Hopf Frame Compilation

> Exact and Fault-Tolerant Compilation of Hopf Differential Frames, by Ruge Lin. Proofs and finite checks for prescribed complete Hopf frames under exact one-qubit/CNOT and coherent Clifford+T resource models.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation

## Use this repository for

- Exact full-frame size, CNOT-count, and clean-workspace/depth tradeoffs.
- T-count versus accuracy and clean/dirty workspace, including one-clean synthesis.
- Simultaneous real-frame T-count/T-depth bounds in explicit precision/workspace regimes.
- Literal diagonals, complete one-target multiplexors, and fixed-decoder Hopf QBP robustness.
- Packed two-clean diagonals and precision-uniform one-clean O(N+L) real and complex magnitude frames, with optimal banked T-count and sharp high-precision endpoints.

## Selected claims

Start with manuscript/PUBLICATION_SCOPE.md for the complete hypotheses and formulas; docs/README.md maps every proof dependency.

- A: Exact real and phase-dressed complex magnitude frames have size Theta(N), CNOT count Theta(N) for n>=2 (zero for n=1), and depth Theta(n+N/(n+m)) for every clean budget m>=0, N=2^n.
- B: T*=Theta(sqrt(NL)+L+NL/q), G=O(NL), for real and complex magnitude frames with sufficient clean allocation a>=C(n+h), q=n+a+b, h=1+ceil(log2(L+n+2)).
- C: One-clean real-frame T=O(N+L ell_*(n)), G=O(NL), at b>=L+n+7; banked and complex extensions have separately stated reservations.
- D: Two-clean real-frame T=O(sqrt(NL)+NL/b+nL), D_T=O(NL/b^2+nL), G=O(NL), at b>=17(L+n+7). The low-precision corollary and explicit matching intervals are in the selected claim ledger.
- Selected precision-uniform one-clean count theorem: T=O(N+L), G=O(NL), with universal constants for n>=3 and every integer L>=6 at error 2^(-L); a=1 and base dirty reservation B=L+n+7 for complete real frames or B=L+n+8 for phase-dressed complex magnitude frames. Every b>=B is allowed. At EXACTLY b=B and L>=max(6,n), the existing width-dependent lower bound gives T*=Theta(N+L).
- Selected optimal banked count: for the same n,L and two frame families, a=1 and b>=2B give T*=Theta(sqrt(NL)+L+NL/b), G=O(NL). This matches throughout the displayed banked widths, without claiming the full transition between B and 2B. No new T-depth guarantee follows.
- Earlier two-clean results remain valid. At L=N the sharper endpoint keeps a=2 and b=N+n+7 for BOTH families and gives 2N-1<=T*<=O(N), hence T*=Theta(N). The one-clean real theorem attains the same count and dirty width; the one-clean complex theorem reserves N+n+8.

Here 0<eta<=1/64 and L=max{6,ceil(log2(1/eta))}. Upper bounds hold for all admitted parameters; matching lower bounds are worst-case over the named family. T-depth permits arbitrary Clifford interlayers and is not total depth. Supplied parameters admit certified evaluation; classical preprocessing is separate from quantum gate counts.

The full initialized-isometry contract includes arbitrary logical and dirty/reference inputs, literal phases, and clean leakage. Return promises depend on the construction: exact synthesis returns all work exactly; B returns dirty work exactly; one-clean operator-core return is approximate within the norm. Actual adjoints and inactive conditional-work sectors are essential. No QRAM, reset, postselection, supplied catalyst, or free evaluator is assumed.

## Read by purpose

- [Claim-led argument](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/REVIEW.md): The problem, A-D, the selected one-clean count frontier, their mechanisms, and operational consequence.
- [Selected claim ledger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/manuscript/PUBLICATION_SCOPE.md): Canonical assumptions, formulas, retained corollaries, and limits.
- [Proof dependencies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/README.md): A-D, the selected one-clean count frontier and sharp two-clean endpoint, and their supporting lemmas.
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md): Evidence by claim, reproduction, and implementation boundaries.
- [Source map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/SOURCE_MAP.md): Imported premises and local contributions; stable detailed catalogue linked there.
- [Resource questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/OPEN_PROBLEM.md): Precision-uniform one-clean real and complex magnitude count, optimal banked count, sharp high-precision endpoints, and the remaining large-workspace real-frame depth question; literal targets and scoped reductions.
- [Research results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/README.md): The precision-uniform growing-source theorem and its dependencies, earlier restricted compilers, scoped representation limits, and preserved evidence. Consult this catalogue for individual research routes; their local open steps do not reopen the resolved count theorem.
- [Packed diagonal compiler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/OPERATOR_SOURCE_COMPILER.md): Section 8 gives error 2^(-ell), T=O(N+ell), G=O(N ell), two clean flags, and b=n+1+ceil((ell+4)/2); matching banked bound at twice that base reservation.
- [Precision-uniform growing-source theorem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/GROWING_SOURCE_COMPILER.md#11-precision-uniform-one-clean-count): T=O(N+L), G=O(NL), for n>=3, integer L>=6, error 2^(-L), one clean flag and b>=L+n+7 (real) or b>=L+n+8 (complex magnitude). A borrowed conjugate signal leaves the genuine initialized recovery anchor intact. The baseline covers modest precision and bounded n. Section 12 banks the exact native queries and matches T*=Theta(sqrt(NL)+L+NL/b) at twice those respective dirty reservations. Sources, rejection modes, actual dirty replay, coarse interlayers and complete recovery are charged. Literal phase dressing shares the sole clean flag and dirty pool under the full initialized-isometry bound. Section 9 retains the sharper TWO-clean complex endpoint b=N+n+7 at L=N.
- [Finite-evidence catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/reference/VERIFICATION_CATALOGUE.md): Proof-to-module/test correspondence, exact finite native words, bounded matrix diagnostics, and their separate evidence limits.
- [Completed state-based QBP supplement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/supplements/state_based_qbp/README.md): Different-decoder results with their own proof, cost, and native-evidence map; not a fine complete-frame compiler or an application speedup claim.

## Status and attribution

GROWING_SOURCE_COMPILER Section 11 proves precision-uniform one-clean O(N+L) count and O(NL) Clifford cost at its stated real and complex reservations; Section 12 proves the optimal banked count frontier at twice those base dirty widths. Section 10 preserves the earlier two-clean proof. The real and complex magnitude high-precision count endpoints remain 2N-1<=T*<=O(N), hence T*=Theta(N), for N=2^n, n>=3, eta=2^(-N), a=2 and b=N+n+7; Section 9 supplies the sharper complex reservation. FAULT_TOLERANT_COMPILER Section 10.3 proves the lower bound using root angle pi/16, unrestricted workspace and the literal-phase contract; zero leaf phases carry this witness into the complex magnitude family. Section 10.4 gives return rigidity below that threshold. Large-workspace T-depth remains open. Source- and query-specific obstructions remain distinct from unrestricted lower bounds. Internal review and finite tests are not external peer review, formal proof certification, or a general native emitter.

Use the exact consulted commit and CITATION.cff for attribution. The repository is MIT licensed. Collaborations: gogoko699@gmail.com.
